public.name: VeriTile.Bench.TritonBenchG.MatmulTriton2.FPCorrect.matmul_triton2_backend_correctness
public.statement:
specification matmul_triton2_backend_correctness {α : Type} [Inhabited α]
    (rest : Algebra α) (P : Primitives α) (p : Parameters) (initial : State α)
    (hBK : 0<p.blockInner) (hInj : Function.Injective (FPValue.cOffset p initial)) :
    ∃ final, FP.Structural.exec (backend rest P) (source p) initial=some final ∧
      Post P p initial final

public.name: VeriTile.Bench.TritonBenchG.MatmulTriton2.FPCorrect.matmul_triton2_machine_correctness
public.statement:
specification matmul_triton2_machine_correctness
    (rest : Algebra Word) (mode : InputMode) (cfg : FP.Config) (plans : ∀ n, ReductionPlan n)
    (p : Parameters) (initial : State Word)
    (hBK : 0<p.blockInner) (hInj : Function.Injective (FPValue.cOffset p initial)) :
    ∃ final, FP.Structural.exec (backend rest (software mode cfg plans)) (source p) initial=some final ∧
      (∀ i, FPValue.active p initial i → final.mem p.output (FPValue.cOffset p initial i)=
        .mk .fp32 (expected mode cfg plans p initial i)) ∧
      (∀ r o, (r≠p.output ∨ ∀ i : CIndex p, FPValue.active p initial i → o≠FPValue.cOffset p initial i) →
        final.mem r o=initial.mem r o) ∧
      (∀ k : Fin p.blockInner, some k ∈ (plans p.blockInner).tree.leaves)

public.name: VeriTile.Bench.TritonBenchG.MatmulTriton2.FPCorrect.matmul_triton2_row_major_machine_correctness
public.statement:
specification matmul_triton2_row_major_machine_correctness
    (rest : Algebra Word) (mode : InputMode) (cfg : FP.Config) (plans : ∀ n, ReductionPlan n)
    (p : Parameters) (initial : State Word)
    (hBK : 0<p.blockInner) (hcn : p.outputColumn=1) (hBN : p.blockColumns≤p.outputRow) :
    ∃ final, FP.Structural.exec (backend rest (software mode cfg plans)) (source p) initial=some final ∧
      Post (software mode cfg plans) p initial final

accepted_scope: Complete original exact-multiple K=BK*steps stage: grouped program IDs, six arbitrary strides, every dynamic cdiv K-loop iteration, original K input masks and final M/N output mask.

conditions.shape: K=BK*steps by Parameters.inner definition; ragged K was not in old accepted scope

aliases: Input, weight and output may alias arbitrarily; all loop reads finish before the final store.
reference: Independent initial-memory values, all active output cells, full nonwritten frame including inactive lanes; no final-output or finite-value premise.
source_bridge: Whole source_projection includes grouped addresses, dynamic loop, masks and default DotOptions={}; same-format fp32 cast materializes generic frontend dtype and preserves bits. Zero uses generated real tag carrying machine +0 only.

profiles.dot: actual options={} preserved; some fp32 compute; no allowTF32=false inserted
profiles.software: Explicit input projection then FP.mul and a complete valid ReductionPlan; additional independent outer FP.add. Arbitrary projection remains available through backend/Primitives.

quantizer_proofs: roundedMagnitude_nearest: encoded magnitude lies on 8192 grid and within 4096 units; tie resolution is explicit
tf32_grid: non-NaN/non-infinity input projection has low 13 bits zero, including possible overflow to infinity
projection_vectors: two midpoint rules, odd midpoint, signed zero, overflow, signaling NaN
witness: Three K blocks, BK=2, final partial M group at pid5, arbitrary six-stride address form, out=A; output tile 2x2 has one active lane A[30], inactive aliased A[31]/A[37] framed. All three modes execute: fullFP32=0x40c00003; named TF32 modes=0x40c00000. Supporting small software regression, not a native launch test.
native_status: pending; no GPU or offline native compilation run
native_primitives: default dot precision under target/version/fp32_default knob
TF32 conversion rounding, subnormals and NaN policy
dot product and accumulation precision/tree plus outer-add contraction
typed memory, address width, allocation window and launch legality

native_local_source_evidence.observation: Unspecified dot precision consults fp32_default; supported targets otherwise default to tf32. None of the named software modes is inferred to be native default.

source_memory_boundary.description: A/B loads mask K only. For partial M/N output tiles they read full input tiles, including logical-shape-exterior addresses. Local M=N=16 tests and min32 autotuning tiles exhibit this address issue. Total-memory value theorem does not establish native allocation safety; original allocation-window conditions remain separate. No padding premise or modified input mask added.

remaining_scope: Other Python caller dtypes are outside the explicit fp32 profile.
Ragged K beyond prior accepted exact-multiple stage is not claimed.
No native default-input-precision, dot-tree, fusion, memory or cross-program race equivalence is established.
old_public_statements_unchanged: Entire old MatmulTriton2.lean byte-identical to pre-task SHA, including output_summary_general and io_correctness.
